entities.name: Thalakos
entities.description: A species of insane, Spirit-like beings trapped in the Shadows of Rath.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: Race caught with the Thalakos and Soltari in the conflict and maelstrom.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: Race in conflict with the Dauthi.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane whose surrounding energy maelstrom trapped the three races.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Thalakos originally lived.

entities.name: Shadows
entities.description: The extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria.

events.summary: During their planeshift the Thalakos are caught in the Dauthi-Soltari conflict and trapped in the Shadows between Rath and Dominaria, losing their sanity.
events.quote: This predicament led the Thalakos to lose their sanity.

relations.quote: trapped within the "Shadows," the extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria
